name: VIDSYNC
request: I want to create a simple video player app for Linux that starts and stops playback from Audacity 4.0 when the play or stop button is pressed.  It doesn't have to syncronize with the Audacity 4.0 timeline, but it does need to have the ability to select a starting point by typing in a time in hours:minutes:seconds.  This way the video player start point an Audacity 4.0 start point can be manually set before playback is started from the video player.  The video player does not have to play audio. But it does need to play most any format of video. I would like for the app to be in .appimage format, if possible.

last_reply: I removed the empty-stage prompt, the sample-clip shortcut and drag-and-drop, so videos now load only through the built-in browser and the picture area stays black until a file is opened. The settings panel now includes a **Keep on top** switch, and the choice is remembered between launches. I rebuilt the AppImage and verified the screenshot, self-test, and the switch working both on and off; the Audacity-following behavior is unchanged. The one remaining uncertainty is a pure Wayland desktop, which may ignore the keep-above request. A useful next step would be remembering the last folder you browsed so opening videos takes fewer clicks.
